rule: No network learning exchange can influence another organization until an audit log records source role, anonymized lesson, minimum sample evidence, consent, approval, rollback, and blocked payment-custody route.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or unlogged exchange can reach recommendation weights in phase one.
audit_principles: Write an audit event before exchanged learning changes a recommendation.
Record only anonymized lesson references, never tenant-private memory.
Attach minimum sample evidence to every cross-organization lesson.
Keep consent and named human approval beside the exchange event.
Store rollback state so every network learning effect can be reversed.
Show the blocked payment route as part of the audit record.
Separate buyer, supplier, and founder audit trails so each role can inspect what changed and why.

role_audit_logs.lesson_reference: fresh proof plus fast response pattern
proof density and response reliability pattern

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Exchange Policy Audit Log after the Network Learning Exchange.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show audit event, lesson reference, sample evidence, consent, approver, rollback, and blocked payment route.
Copy output explains what lesson was logged, what evidence supports it, who approved it, where it applies, and which payment route stayed blocked.
Build Phase shows the v172 Exchange Policy Audit Log contract after the Network Learning Exchange contract.
Docs include audit states, audit routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required audit fields.
Static check fails if the audit UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No network exchange can reach recommendation weights without an audit event in phase one.
